stories.title: 2 arrested after $50K Newnan Best Buy theft leads to I-85 chase, police say
stories.summary: Coweta County deputies recovered roughly $50,000 in stolen merchandise after stopping the fleeing vehicle near mile marker 50.

stories.title: Suspect arrested for Facebook Marketplace robbery after being spotted by Flock camera
stories.summary: Police say 20-year-old Patrice Saddler Jackson dragged and ran over the victim with her car after taking a cell phone without paying at a Buford Drive gas station.

stories.title: Civil rights attorney Ben Crump joins legal team for family of teen fatally shot by Henry County officer
stories.summary: Crump, alongside co-counsel and mother Taneshia Puckett, demanded that Henry County officials release body camera footage from the Nov. 3 shooting of Tyrie Howse.

stories.title: Man arrested in Florida, charged with murder in connection to 3-year-old's death in Atlanta
stories.summary: The child died from a gunshot wound following a late-night shooting in April in the Peoplestown neighborhood.

stories.title: Viral couple from Georgia Tech game go on Today Show, explain there was 'zero speculation between us about breaking up'
stories.summary: The students, Tallulah Wall and Braden Flournoy, were captured during a disagreement - and later, a makeup kiss - on the ESPN broadcast of Saturday's Tech game.

stories.title: Lagrange Police credit FLOCK for helping them locate missing 'disoriented' 75-year-old man
stories.summary: Family reported that he displayed early signs of dementia but had not been officially diagnosed with it, police said.

stories.title: Traffic Alert: Exit ramp off of I-20 WB in Covington closes after semi-truck overturns
stories.summary: No injuries have been reported at this time.

stories.title: Brothers acquitted in Sandy Springs apartment complex shooting after claims of self-defense
stories.summary: The case originated with a shooting in April.

stories.title: DA: Man sentenced to life after sexually abusing 7-year-old girl who later tested positive for STD in Fulton County
stories.summary: The incident occurred in November 2023 while her mom traveled out of state for a funeral, according to the District Attorney's Office.

stories.title: GDOT plans overnight lane closures on I-285 for Chattahoochee River bridge repairs
stories.summary: Crews will make a localized repair to the bridge joint using concrete, which GDOT expects to last longer than the asphalt used during a recent weekend repair.

stories.title: Cement truck crashes into pedestrian, apartment building in Atlanta; nearly 2,000 customers lose power
stories.summary: Georgia Power reported nearly 2,000 outages connected to the incident. It was not immediately clear how long power would remain out.

stories.title: 20 structures destroyed in latest count following 10-acre Gilmer County wildfire
stories.summary: An additional seven were affected and one more had minor damage, according to Gilmer County Emergency Management.
